text.p: Inno-Pacific Holding Ltd said on Friday it had acquired investment holding company Granfeld Pte Ltd.
Granfeld, a wholly-owned subsidiary, has an authorised capital of $100,000 comprising 100,000 shares of Singapore $1.00 each and a paid-up capital of $2.00.
In a statement, Inno-Pacific said Granfeld was in the process of changing its name to Tianjin Investments Pte Ltd, and will act as an intermediate holding company for its investments in China.
Separately, it said its subsidiary Shakey's Holdings Pte Ltd has bought a wholly-owned subsidiary, Shakey's Asia Pacific Pte Ltd (Shakey's AP).
The unit has an authorised capital of $100,000 and a paid-up capital of $2.00. The company will operate and manage Shakey's outlets for its pizza franchise in Singapore.
The above transactions would not have any significant effect on its earnings for the finacial year ending December 31, 1997.
